educationalModelNote: All numerical models are simplified educational models, not specifications of a real robot.

missions.title: HAZARDS & RISK
missions.concept: Risk is not a vague feeling: severity, exposure and probability combine, and mitigations should reduce risk by changing the physical or operational conditions.
missions.scenario: Assess a moving-arm hazard near a public interaction zone.
missions.goalText: Reduce risk by changing exposure/probability rather than pretending severity disappeared.
missions.transferText: Restore an acceptable risk level after exposure increases.

missions.title: PROTECTIVE STOPS & STO
missions.concept: A protective stop must manage kinetic/gravitational energy into a safe state; simply removing torque can create a fall hazard.
missions.scenario: Stop a moving humanoid before a boundary while preserving upright support.
missions.goalText: Stop inside the available zone without demanding an unrealistic deceleration.
missions.transferText: Adapt speed/latency after safe deceleration authority falls.

missions.title: FMEA & FTA
missions.concept: Failure analysis separates severity, occurrence and detectability, then asks how single faults combine into hazardous top events.
missions.scenario: Prioritize a sensor fault and decide where diagnostic coverage matters most.
missions.goalText: Reduce the priority by improving occurrence or detectability; severity is not magically editable.
missions.transferText: Increase diagnostic strength after occurrence risk rises.

missions.title: RELIABILITY & AVAILABILITY
missions.concept: Reliability describes time to failure; availability also depends on repair/recovery time. A highly reliable robot can still be unavailable if recovery is slow.
missions.scenario: Plan a fleet service target from MTBF and MTTR.
missions.goalText: Meet both mission reliability and fleet availability goals.
missions.transferText: Recover availability by improving reliability or service recovery.

missions.title: V&V, FAULT INJECTION & CYBER
missions.concept: Verification evidence grows when requirements are exercised under representative faults and adversarial conditions; test count alone is not coverage.
missions.scenario: Build an evidence plan that combines nominal tests, fault injection and cyber controls.
missions.goalText: Create broad evidence without ignoring fault and cyber exposure.
missions.transferText: Compensate for increased attack surface with stronger verification and controls.

missions.title: SAFETY GATE
missions.concept: Demonstrate hazard reasoning, managed stopping, failure analysis, availability and evidence discipline under faults.
missions.scenario: Release a public-operation safety case for one service mission.
missions.goalText: Complete the three safety gate cases.

gateCases.name: PROTECTIVE STOP
gateCases.text: Total stopping distance must stay below 0.5 m.

gateCases.name: RESIDUAL RISK
gateCases.text: Residual uncovered/undetected space must be below 8%.
